# Whiteboard Video Maker Buying Checklist: Preview to Export


Check a whiteboard video maker before paying: preview versus download, watermarks, commercial rights, export limits, annual billing and real production cost.


Mira Chen


•


June 30, 2026 •


4 min read


Before paying for a whiteboard video maker, check the file you can actually download, the license you need, and the cost of the configuration you will use. This checklist takes you from a free preview to a production purchase. For tool descriptions and current prices, use the[seven-tool whiteboard animation software comparison](https://video.golpoai.com/guide/best-whiteboard-animation-software) .


## Write down the finished deliverable


Specify duration, aspect ratio, resolution, language, visual style, watermark policy, and where the video will appear. Add whether you need source projects, a presenter, your own narration, or programmatic generation. A plan that can preview your idea may still be unable to export the configuration your audience needs.


## Free preview, free trial, and downloadable video


Offer What to verify


Free preview Can you only watch inside the product, or download a file?


Free trial When does it expire, what is watermarked, and does billing start automatically?


Free plan What are the export, duration, resolution, asset, and commercial-use limits?


Paid export Are the selected assets and features covered by the plan, or charged separately?


For example, Golpo Free provides one 1-minute watermarked preview; download it without a watermark for $9.99, or subscribe to download it at no extra charge. Starter costs $39.99/month, billed monthly, and includes watermark-free downloads at no extra download charge. A preview is useful for evaluation; it does not supply a free file for publishing. Check[Golpo pricing](https://video.golpoai.com/pricing) .


## Check these before subscribing


1. **Export one representative file.** Play it outside the editor. Inspect labels, narration, first and last frames, audio, watermark, and the real resolution.
2. **Read the license.** Check commercial use, selling client videos, stock assets, music, and whether your client needs a rights transfer.
3. **Count exports and retries.** Distinguish projects, downloads, generation credits, and charged revisions.
4. **Read the billing basis.** “Per month, billed yearly” usually commits a year of payment; it is not a monthly installment offer.
5. **Check access after cancellation.** Save permitted exports and source assets, and verify what remains editable.
6. **Test your working environment.** Confirm the desktop or browser workflow on the machine and network you use.


## Compare cost per accepted video


Use your actual volume: allocated subscription cost + paid generation or revision credits + licensed assets + hands-on production and review. Divide by videos accepted for publication, not drafts generated.


For example, a $180 annual subscription is a $15 monthly equivalent but a $180 upfront commitment. If you accept three videos in a month, the allocated subscription portion is $5 each before labor and extras. That is an illustration of the arithmetic, not a quote for a particular production.


## When Golpo plan features affect the purchase


- **Preview and export:** Free provides one 1-minute, watermarked preview; download it without a watermark for $9.99, or subscribe to download it at no extra charge. Starter is $39.99/month, billed monthly, with 20 credits and watermark-free downloads at no extra download charge.
- **Presenters:** Golpo supports AI Presenter, including custom photo-based presenters and stock Golpo Avatars. The published rate is 5 credits/minute for a custom presenter or 3 credits/minute for a stock Avatar, available from Creator and on Pay As You Go. See[Golpo Avatar](https://video.golpoai.com/guide/golpo-ai-avatar-guide) and the[stock presenter guide](https://video.golpoai.com/guide/golpo-stock-avatars-guide) .
- **API:** Business lists API access as a $200 add-on; Scale includes API access. API Only is a separate usage-based offering with a $200 minimum commitment. Ordinary Pay As You Go does not include API access.
- **Editing:** Paid plans support visual frame editing. Correct spoken wording in the script and render again; a visual frame edit does not rewrite narration. Review the[editing guide](https://video.golpoai.com/guide/golpo-video-editing-guide) before estimating revision work.


These are published plan terms, not performance measurements. Confirm your required configuration on the[current pricing page](https://video.golpoai.com/pricing) .


## Measure total production time


Record setup, script preparation, queueing, rendering, hands-on corrections, and final review separately. Use the same brief when comparing tools. A first render is not an accepted deliverable, and a vendor's demonstration is not your production-time measurement.


## Make the purchase decision


Buy the smallest option that produces your required, licensed, downloadable file at the volume you need. Keep a manual scene editor in the shortlist when exact placement matters; evaluate generation when your main task is turning source content into an explanation.
